selected.name: Your Usual Table
selected.idea: The real lantern-lit dining room unfolds beside a warm invitation on a tall restaurant menu.
selected.emotion: The familiar welcome of a family-run room you can settle into.
selected.composition: A panoramic window into the actual dining room sits behind a tall cream invitation offset to the right, with a broad red rail carrying the restaurant name at left. The cream panel layers across the photographic edge, and a restrained terracotta frame ties the two together. Mobile keeps the tall real room on one side and the invitation overlapping its lower edge, so the restaurant remains present around the words.
selected.motion: The dining room uncovers first, the cream invitation slides upward once, and a fine frame completes; fully still by 2.2 seconds.

selected.name: Magnolia Morning
selected.idea: The real magnolia canopy becomes the invitation, with a quiet cream nameplate beside it.
selected.emotion: Fresh air, a familiar stop and a slower breath before the day.
selected.composition: An edge-to-edge photograph fills the right three-fifths; oversized rose Tinos lettering lives on a narrow cream column that steps into the image. On phones the full hut sits below the name.
selected.motion: The photo opens like a wide curtain, the two brand lines rise into place, and a fine rose line draws once; settled by 2.2 seconds.
selected.note: This is the exact option you named. Full page is ready to review.
